title: Let successor launch pass model and effort
body:
Outcome: krn-handoff successors start as `claude --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort max` (operator 2026-11-01, verbatim: "od nastepnej sesji opusa uzywaj opus 5.5 /effort", "max effort mozesz uzywac"; memory successor-model-effort). scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts parseArgs accepts only --name, --prompt, --cwd.
Proof: successor-launch test shows the herdr and background command lines carry --model and --effort; the krn-handoff skill passes them.
